title: Design: Long Bill To name is cut at the card edge with no ellipsis
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer B, the customer the work is for, so each work order bills someone else.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, with a name longer than 25 characters, with spaces (for example "Valders Diesel & Fleet Repair").
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer C, with a long name with no spaces, at least 50 characters (for example NorthernPlainsHeavyTruckandTrailerRepairServicesWest).
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer D, with a name that includes each of the characters & " ' < > (for example A&B "Fleet" O'Neil <Parts> & Sons).
  • If a name field stops before the end of a name, use the longest name it takes.
  • Have a new open work order for this test, work order 1, for customer B with customer A picked as its Bill To, so a work order bills a customer other than its own.
  • Have a new open work order for this test, work order 2, for customer B with customer C picked as its Bill To, so a work order bills a customer other than its own.
  • Have a new open work order for this test, work order 3, for customer B with customer D picked as its Bill To, so a work order bills a customer other than its own.
  • Open the attached pictures bt-p2-06-after-picked.png, bt-p2-08-after-s2-17579.png at 100% zoom beside the screen.
custom_steps:
1. Open work order 1.
  2. Open work order 2.
  3. Open work order 3.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Bill To shows the start of customer A's name cut at the card's right edge (for example "Valders Diesel & Fleet Re"), with no "..." and no tooltip.

Step 2:

  • Bill To shows the start of customer C's name cut at the card's right edge, with no "..." and no tooltip.
  • No part of customer C's name runs past the card into the page beside it.

Step 3:

  • Bill To shows customer D's name, cut at the card's right edge if it is longer than the card, with no "...".
  • Every character of customer D's name that shows appears exactly as typed: & " ' < > are not changed into other characters or codes.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Bill To", Confluence 1003585538, version 0.5 (6 Nov 2026, pending approval, Chris Ward), read 9 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-12289, story SV-12305 (Story 3, Bill To on the work order and part sale Customer card)

  • S3-R2: “The field reads "This customer" when the customer pays for itself, otherwise the Bill To's name.”
